newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki sees clearly higher 96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki sees clearly higher 96 profit.

text.p: Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy said on Friday it expected 1996 profit to show a clear improvement over 1995.
"For the full year, a clear profit improvement is expected," Huhtamaki said in a statement with its January-August results.

"The divestment of Leiras, finalised on September 2, and the likely sale before year-end of the remaining eye medicine business, Star, will result in an extraordinary income of around one billion markka," it said.
In full-year 1995, Huhtamaki reported a 312 million markka profit after financial items, with net profit of 180 million markka after a 44 million markka extraordinary charge.
The company said the benefits of restructuring its Leaf confectionery unit would become visible in 1997.
